notes.title: Online Mode Patch - Quick Fixes
notes.content:
Added some quick fixes to online mode as I had just encountered a few:

- names had previously not loaded properly, that has been fixed.
- player count was not showing room player count, should be fixed now
- scene sync has now been implemented, as before players would load in first before others.

notes.title: Online PVP Beta
notes.content: Added a new multiplayer mode, which will be releasing as a beta to test out functionality. Right now, you can play up to 4 players a session. Since it's in beta, certain features like workshop stats and boss vehicles will not carry on into multiplayer. Will be looking into adding onto this in the future, feel free to try it out with a few friends!

notes.title: New Map, 2 new vehicles
notes.content: Added a new map 'Newport Destroyed', a restructured map of Newport but with some environment changes and adjusted to night, as well as 2 new vehicles, 'Hauler' and 'Road Runner'. Both vehicles have new specials introduced to the game as well.

notes.title: Map Creator Update
notes.content:
Added a new Map Creator mode that allows you to create maps for Exhibition and Tower mode! Also added in a new boss vehicle, 'Demolisher'. Some changes/fixes as well:

- Tower mode reduced to 4 matches a piece (originally 6)
- Auto missiles (pink electric) had a glitch where the auto aim would target the user, should be fixed now.
- glitch where machine guns fire in tower transitions has been fixed.

notes.title: v1.071 - quick update, bug fixes
notes.content: Quick update, had some bug fixes, tower mode glitch where cars were controlled during tower transitions do not move anymore. Also changed later storylines to have some newer maps in the game.

notes.title: New vehicles in tower - Fury Empath and CA1
notes.content: Added 2 new vehicles that can be unlocked in Tower mode, Fury Empath and CA1

notes.title: New Map, CPU adjustments
notes.content: Added a new map called Broken Highways that can be unlocked in Tower Mode. Also adjusted the navigation system of CPUs a bit, creating map points for a few maps, should help the AI navigate out of areas they tend to get stuck in.

notes.title: Map Additions - Tower Mode
notes.content: Added 2 new maps that can be unlocked in Tower Mode, Junkyard and IA4. IA4 being a map from Project annihilation that was remade, and restructured a bit, for this game, and a new map all-together that may be reminiscent of other junkyard maps made in the series!

notes.title: Tower Mode - v1.03
notes.content:
Added Tower Mode, go through 6 rounds of the tower, in which you can unlock 3 vehicles. 3 new vehicles added to the game:

-Cuda
-Rider
-Justice

Other changes:

-physics collisions have been adjusted to tone down super collision speeds.
-a few maps were adjusted by texture, Farmyard and Death Plains.
-some vehicle stat adjustments.

notes.title: Map Update - v1.02
notes.content:
Added new elements to 3 maps in particular: Newport, Neolectric, and Site 37. Changes are as listed:


Newport:
- Minor building changes.
- Added civilian vehicles within the map, which are destroyable

Neolectric:
- Added building sections to the corners of the ramp sections.
- Added spot light visuals, also located in the corners of the ramp sections.

Site 37:
- Adjusted building textures of the 2 major buildings.
- Added ETs within the area that set off giant explosions when destroyed.

Airport:
- minor changes to collision, some plane parts that weren't exploding before, will now.

notes.title: Gameplay Sliders
notes.content: Added gameplay sliders to adjust health, ai aggression, and boost power. This update also comes with a boost in health across the board of vehicles, can be adjusted in the slider section in the Options menu. AI aggression and Boost power are the same as before, but can also be adjusted in the menus

notes.title: Added stat showing in player selection menus
notes.content: Added stat showing in player selection menus, also fixed a glitch in the secret boss battle where losing to the secret boss would automatically let you win.
